//: Type-checking + editor support for the Playwright e2e suite. Run via `tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json --noEmit` in `npm run typecheck` — Playwright transpiles specs but does NOT type-check them, and esbuild-based runners never type-check. e2e code never ships (not reachable from the app entry), so this has zero production-bundle impact; it only adds a dev-time correctness gate.
